content: Arshe Eqo

Iyaasoy kase Iyarkko katamaa oli dhayssidinne istta kawoza wodhida mala, Aye katama olidi ubbaa dhayssidayssanne istta kawozakka wodhidayssa Yerusalaame kawo Adooni-Xeedeqey siyides. Qasse Geba7oone asay Isra7eele asaara saron de7anaas caaqettidayssanne ha7i isttara issife dizayssa siyides.
Hessan izinne derezi dagammida; gaasoykka Geba7ooney kawota katama mala katamata ubbaafe gita katama; gomppay Aye katamayppe darees; izin diza asaykka mino olanchcha.
Hessa gishshas Yerusalaame kawoy Adooni-Xeedeqey, Kebroone kawo Hohaames, Yarmuute kawo Phir7aames, Laakishe kawo Yaafi7assinne Egiloone kawo Dabirey,
«Geba7oone katamaa asay Iyaasoranne Isra7eele asaara saro deyanaas caaqettida gishshas isttara olettanaas yiidi tana maadderketii!» gides.

Hessafe guye Amooreta kawoti ichchashati Yerusalaame kawoy, Kebroone kawoy, Yarmuute kawoy, Laakishe kawoynne Egiloone kawoy ba olanchchata issife gaththidi ubbaa ekki biidi, Geba7oone katamaa dooddi oykkidi olida.

Geba7oone asay Gelgelan dunkaanida Iyaasokko kiittidi, «Nuna ne aylleta aggofa; eeson nuukko yaada nuna ashsha. Gezze deren diza Amooreta kawoti wuri nuna olanaas ba olanchchata ubbaa shiishshi ekkidi yiza gishshas nuna ne aylleta maadda» gida.
Hessa gishshas Iyaasoy ba olanchchatanne mino asata ubbaa shiishshi ekkidi Gelgelappe kezides.
GODAY Iyaaso, «Ne isttas yayyofa; tani istta ne kushen aaththa immadis; isttafe issaadeyka nenara eqettanaas dandayenna» gides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoy Gelgelappe omarsara hemettishe aqidi istti akeekontta dishin istta bolla worajjides.

GODAY Isra7eele asaa sinththan Amooreta bolla shiro yeddides; Isra7eele asay isttafe daro asaa Geba7oonen wodhides. Isra7eele asay istta Beeti-Horoone efiza oge pudunththan kaallides; Azeeqeppe biidi Maqeeda gakkanaas yedeththi wodhida.

Beeti-Horooneppe duge Azeeqe efiza oge oykkidi istti Isra7eele asaa sinththafe baqatishin GODAY wolqqama shach saloppe istta bolla bukisides. Histtiin Isra7eele asay mashshan wodhida asaappe, shachchay wodhida asay keehippe daro.
GODAY Amooreta Isra7eele asaa kushen aaththi immida gallas Isra7eele asaa sinththan Iyaasoy GODAAS,

Hessa gishshas Isra7eele kawoteththay ba morkketa bolla halo kessana gakkanaas arshey eqqides. Aginaykka qaaxxabeekku. Hessika Yashaare Maxaafan xaafettides; arshey salos giddo addan eqqides; issi gallas kumeth arshey wullontta pe7ides.
GODAY asa qaala siyida hessa mala gallassi hessafe kasekka guyekka hanibeenna. Tumukka GODAY Isra7eele gishshas olettides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne Isra7eele olanchchati ubbay ba dunkaanidaso Gelgela simmida.
Amoore Kawota Ichchashata Hayqo
He wode Amooreta kawoti ichchashati baqati biidi Maqeedan gongolo giddon qotettida.
Iyaasoykka ichchash kawoti Maqeedan gongolo giddon qotetti dizayssa siyides.
Iyaasoy, «Gita shuchchata genderisi efidi gongoloza gordite; histtidi naagana zabeta heen woththite.
Intte morkketa yedeththite attiin azallofte; istta kaalli kaalli meto gaththite; istti ba katamaa bi gelontta mala diggite; hekko GODAA intte Xoossay istta intte kushen aaththi immides» gides.
Hessa gishshas Iyaasoynne Isra7eele asay istta mulera dippi histtida; isttafe attida guuththati kase ba diza gimbettida katamata simmi gelida.
Hessafe guye asay ubbay saron simmidi Iyaasoy dunkaani dizaso Maqeeda yides; Isra7eele asaa bolla issi qaalakka haasayda asi deenna.
Iyaasoy isttas, «Gongoloza doydi he ichchash kawota kessidi taas haa ekki yiite» gides.
Isttika he ichchash kawota Yerusalaame kawo, Kebroone kawo, Yarmuute kawo, Laakishe kawonne Egiloone kawo kessidi izakko ehida.

Istti he kawota Iyaasokko ehiin Iyaasoy Isra7eele attuma asaa ubbaa baakko xeygidi banara diza ola gadawata, «Haa yiidi hayta kawota qoodhe bolla yedhdhi eqqite» gides. Isttika sinth aadhdhidi ba tohon kawota qoodhe bolla yedhdhi eqqida.
Iyaasoykka isttas, «Babofte; dagammofte; minnitenne xalite; inttenara olettiza intte morkketa ubbata bolla GODAY hayssaththo ooththana» gides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoy ichchash kawota wodhidi ichchash miththa bolla istta ahaa kaqqides; omarsi gakkanaas istta ahay miththa bollafe wodhdhibeenna.

Arshey wullana hanishin Iyaasoy azaziin miththaa bollafe kawota ahaa woththidi kase istti qotettida gongolozan efi yeggida. Histtidi gongoloza gita shuchchatan tuccida; he shuchchati hach gakkanaaska heen deettes.
Iyaasoy Xooni Oykkida Hara Katamata

He gallas Iyaasoy Maqeeda katama oykkides; katamayonne izi kawoza giththa mashshan siifides; izi giddon diza asaappe issinokka ashshontta dishe dippi histtides; Iyarkko kawo bolla ooththidayssaththoka Maqeeda kawo bollaka ooththides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne izara diza Isra7eele asay ubbay Maqeedafe Libina biidi olida.

GODAY he katamayonne izi kawoza Isra7eele asaa kushen aaththi immides; Iyaasoy katamayonne izi giddon diza ubbaa issinokka ashshontta giththa mashshan dippi histtides; Iyarkko kawo bolla ooththoyssaththoka Libina kawo bollaka ooththides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne izara diza Isra7eele asay ubbay Libinappe Laakishe bi dooddi olida.

GODAY Laakishe Isra7eele asaa kushen aaththi immides; Iyaasoy he katamayo nam7anththo gallassan oykkides; izi Libinan ooththoyssaththoka hanno ha katamayonne izi giddon diza ubbaa giththa mashshan siifides.
He wode Gezeere kawo Horaamey Laakishe kawo maaddanaas yides; gido attiin Iyaasoy izakka iza asaakka issino ashshontta ubbaa dippi histtides.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne izara diza Isra7eele asay ubbay Laakisheppe Egiloone biidi he katamaa dooddi oykki olida.
He gallas Egiloone oli oykkidi giththa mashshan dhayssida; kase Laakishen ooththida mala Egiloone katamaan diza asaa mulera dhayssida.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne izara diza Isra7eele asa ubbay Egilooneppe kezi biidi Kebroone olida.
He katamayonne katamay giddon diza miish ubbaa issinokka ashshontta giththa mashshan dippi histtida; kase Egiloonen ooththida mala hanno katamay giddon diza ubbaa mulera dippi histtida.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne izara diza Isra7eele asay ubbay guye simmidi Dabire olida.

Katamayonne izi kawoza, izi heeran diza qeeri katamatakka ubbaa giththa mashshan siifida; izi giddon dizayssafe issinokka ashshontta ubbaa dippi histtida; kase Libinaninne Libina kawo bolla ooththida mala, Kebroone bolla ooththoyssaththoka Dabire bollanne izi kawoza bolla ooththida.

Hessaththoka Iyaasoy zumbullati dariza biittaa, Negebe, arshey wulliza baggara diza gadha biittanne zuma laddeta, biitta ubbaa kawotara gaththi oykkides. GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay azazida mala biittaa bolla shemppora diza ubbaa dippi histtides; aykkoka shemppora paxa ashshibeenna.
Iyaasoy istta Qaadeese Barineppe biidi Gaaza gakkanaas, qasse Gooshene biittafe doommidi Geba7oone gakkanaas ubbaa xooni oykkides.
Iyaasoy issito ola kezidi he kawotanne istta biitta ubbaa xoonides. Hessika haniday GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay ba deraas olettida gishshassa.
Hessafe guye Iyaasoynne Isra7eele asay ubbay ba dunkaanidaso Gelgela simmides.
